name: Topological Tide
author: Motif
description: Ivory ceramic and copper metal implicit surfaces with cobalt shadows: gyroid shells, tori, Möbius ribbons and folded plates, sphere-traced with derived Lipschitz bounds. Nine seamless infinite loops.

styles.name: Topological Tide Hero
styles.blurb: An ivory gyroid shell with a copper inner wall and cobalt shadows in its cavities, turning once per loop.

freq.label: Spatial frequency
freq.hint: Gyroid frequency k (cells per radian of object space). Higher = finer lattice.

shell.label: Shell thickness
shell.hint: Wall thickness of the implicit shell, in gyroid units.

bound.label: Bound radius
bound.hint: Radius of the clipping ball. Larger shows more of the lattice.

warp.label: Warp amplitude
warp.hint: Domain warp. The sphere-tracing bound is re-derived for it.

metal.label: Ceramic ↔ metal mix
metal.hint: 0 = all ivory ceramic, 1 = all copper metal. Metal appears on one wall of the shell first.

cavity.label: Cavity contrast
cavity.hint: Strength of ambient occlusion and contact shadows in the cavities.

keyAngle.label: Key direction
keyAngle.hint: Direction of the key light in the picture plane, degrees.

exposure.label: Exposure
exposure.hint: Linear exposure before the single tone map.

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.hint: Glow added around emissive light. 0 shows the bare geometry.

bloomRadius.label: Bloom radius
bloomRadius.hint: Width of the glow relative to the frame.

lensCA.label: Edge fringe
lensCA.hint: Spectral fringing toward the frame edge.

vignette.label: Vignette
vignette.hint: Darkens the frame edge; never touches the focal area.

quality.label: Quality
quality.hint: Sample counts only. Composition, phase and exposure stay the same.
